name: Paris
tagline: Café terraces, Seine bridges and that Eiffel Tower photo.
description: Your Paris trip in one shoot: the Eiffel Tower from Trocadéro and the Champ de Mars, café terraces, Montmartre steps, Haussmann balconies, the Seine bookstalls, rainy cobblestones and a river cruise at blue hour. Trench coats, Breton stripes and soft European light.
